section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the item adaptation process for the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) for the Brazilian population. Only three items (5, 9, and 10) remained unchanged from the previous cross-cultural adaptation by Swami et al. (2011). Changes were made based on participant suggestions and expert input to improve comprehensibility, including modifications to response options (replacing 'rarely' and 'often' with 'almost never' and 'many times') and the addition of a non-verbal scale with visual squares to accompany the verbal response options.
section_summary.evidence_source: Entire section describes the BAS adaptation process for Brazilian adolescents.
